cause: The GUI excluded media tasks from Pause and the helper path had only cancel/finish, without retained pause state or a resume controller.
method: Stop only the owned helper job; persist Paused without cleanup; retain owned staging and a bounded encrypted recipe; resume the same ID, context, selected quality and name with helper continuation; restore paused controller after view/queue owner restart. Merging/verification excludes Pause. Native HTTP/torrent scheduling and completion checks retained.
independentMediaProof: Direct resume used a nonzero byte range and final SHA-256 matched its complete source
Resumed HLS output had full audio/video duration and every decoded video frame matched the source playlist
limitations: Existing running process remains the previous build, with its two video transfers untouched; exit through tray and reopen after they finish to use new controls. Sources may expire or refuse continuation; helpers may re-fetch a fragment. Verification is local private acceptance, not a public-site, remote CI or clean-VM guarantee. No commits, packaging, delegation or publication.
